question: In which year a team of German and Italian archaeologists started surface exploration at Mohenjodaro?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A team of German and Italian archaeologists started surface exploration at **Mohenjodaro in 1980**.
 
• Mohenjodaro is one of the main settlements of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization, located in present-day Pakistan.
 
• The site was first discovered in the 1920s and has been subject to various archaeological studies since then.
 
• The 1980 exploration aimed to further uncover the urban planning and social organization of this ancient city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohenjodaro** is one of the largest settlements of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization and is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
 
• The city is known for its advanced urban planning, including sophisticated drainage systems and well-constructed buildings.
 
• The name Mohenjodaro means "Mound of the Dead" in Sindhi.
 
• Excavations have revealed a highly developed city with a complex social structure and advanced technology for its time.
 
• Despite numerous studies, the script of the Indus Valley Civilization remains undeciphered.
